news.title: Signature Alliance bags RM51.56mil Underwater World Langkawi redevelopment contract

recent_en: SAG recently secured two contracts worth approximately RM103.56mil, involving the Underwater World Langkawi redevelopment project. The company declared an interim dividend of 2.0 sen per share for FY2025, with ex-date on 11 November 2025. In addition, there were changes in director and substantial shareholder interests, a change of company secretary, and a change of address.
notable_en: Secured a RM51.56mil contract for the Underwater World Langkawi redevelopment.
Declared an interim dividend of 2.0 sen per share for FY2025.

Changes in the interests of Directors DATO' BOEY CHIN GAN and MADAM TAN POH CHEOK.
